## Use Hack in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Hack for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Hack', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Hack coding font

Designed for programming, with clear and readable characters. Hack is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Hack is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Hack FAQ

### Is Hack free?

Yes. Hack is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Hack support ligatures?

No. Hack has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Hack?

Hack is available from GitHub and Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
